forum.title: New Community invites me to edit tags, then tells me I can't!
forum.best_answer_content: @Andrew Neil , great! The team performed the necessary sync and you should not face issues when editing content. If you do, let me know.
forum.content_text:
Example [here](https://community.st.com/feedback-forum-118/can-t-edit-post-title-165974?postid=165974#post165974):

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/ad202532-c5ce-4fc5-b6e3-e5502f6bb929.png)

So it invites me to “edit tags”.

It even lets me add more tags:

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/a0c97fad-ca32-422d-9f19-39d5b3b0156a.png)

But, when I press ‘Save’, it refuses:

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/cb7a4040-bed0-4ffb-ba1c-987326a9f836.png)
forum.author: Andrew Neil

scraped_replies.html: @Andrew Neil , great! The team performed the necessary sync and you should not face issues when editing content. If you do, let me know.

Thanks for reporting.

I was not able to replicate the issues as all user have the right to edit tags on their own posts. 

Let me check what’s the issue and get back. 

Lina

Does the issue still persist? If yes, please test in an incognito window.

Thanks a lot,
